Title: Generally available: Kafka Connect support in Azure Event Hubs

Body.Content:
With Kafka Connect support GA, users can seamlessly and reliably stream data between Azure Event Hubs and external systems such as databases, key-value stores, file systems and other data sources. 

With the full compatibility with Kafka Connect APIs, user can run any source or sink Kafka Connector against Event Hubs Kafka API.
